boundary: Exploratory CPU geometry screen for a source-weighted visual skin candidate at three fixed kinematic snapshots. It does not qualify continuous motion, contact, tissue mechanics, shell closure, clinical anatomy, or the native renderer implementation.

candidate.blend: full_ABI5_vertex_weight_field; hemisphere-align each influence to the maximum-weight influence; normalize real and dual parts; orthogonalize dual part
candidate.geometry: source positions and source face indices unchanged; no weight or pose tuning; normals excluded from this geometric screen

control: The exact retained ABI5 source-weight native LBS pack at the same pose. Before candidate scoring, CPU LBS reconstructed from the pinned source model and pose must match each source skin pack within 2e-6 m maximum vertex error.
experimental_unit: One deterministic pose snapshot; the three poses are repeated kinematic conditions on one source model, not independent biological samples.

fixed_settings.precision: float64 transforms and predicates; emitted candidate coordinates rounded to float32 for parity with native pack

prediction: At each preregistered pose, dual-quaternion skinning introduces no exact triangle-pair intersections absent from the source-weight LBS control and does not increase the exact pair count.
primary_observable: Exact triangle self-intersection pair identities on the complete ABI5 outer skin after quotienting only bit-identical float32 coordinates.
purpose: test whether the source-weight LBS deformation formulation contributes to the known sampled skin-shell crossings, without tuning weights or anatomy
question: Does normalized dual-quaternion blending of the same source skin weights and rigid body transforms avoid worsening exact shell self-intersections relative to native LBS at the retained bilateral knee snapshots?
refutation: Any new exact triangle pair or higher candidate pair count at any pose refutes the preregistered non-regression prediction. Missing source identity, failed rest reconstruction, or LBS-to-native parity error above 2e-6 m makes that pose inconclusive.
stopping_rule: Reconstruct and parity-check LBS for the three fixed poses, then run one exact CPU predicate on each DQ candidate; stop after these three cases. Do not adopt or implement a runtime renderer path based on this screen alone.
